name: AndonLineBoard
tagline: Line-side andon calls with live timers, escalation and one-tap acknowledge/resolve – in Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: A manufacturing andon board PCF control: station tiles per line for safety, maintenance, quality, material and team-leader calls, live response timers, a configurable escalation matrix per call type, acknowledge/escalate/resolve with reason codes, KPIs (open, unacknowledged, escalated, stations stopped, response time) and a call log saved as JSON in one column.
features: KPI strip: open, unacknowledged, escalated, stations stopped, longest open, average response, % on time
Station tiles per line with call colours, pulsing alerts, ACK and escalation badges
Escalation matrix per call type with automatic and manual escalation
Acknowledge, escalate, resolve with reason codes and validated notes; raise calls from any station
Calls table on desktop, cards and bottom sheet on phones
Line and call-type filters, search, read-only wallboard mode, translatable labels
15 outputs plus a browser event for Power Pages
